ranking.name: Quality Inn & Suites Maison St. Charles

text.text_excerpt: This is a lovely hotel in the garden district. Rooms are grouped into three courtyards with pools, fountains,and tables and chairs in the middle to encourage interaction, but also to provide quiet public spaces for guests. Rooms are clean and comfortable, but nothing special. Our rom included a refrigerator and a microwave as well as ample room. Service was a bit spotty; we asked for extra pillows which were promised, but never delivered. The tiny bathroom showed cigarette burns on the ledge of the bathtub and the plumbing is not the greatest, but overall it was a fine experience. Got a deal through Travelzoo that included free parking so great value Ok so first off don't go here expecting a 5 star hotel. The buildings are old and a little rough around the edges. Heck it's New Orleans people. Everything is old! That aside this is now my go to place to stay. Room was clean, location is amazing, staff is friendly and helpful. Our bed was very comfortable and the AC worked great.The free breakfast in the morning is typical but each day offered a something a little different. One day it was biscuits and gravy, one day sausage and eggs. They also have the typical waffle iron, cereal, yogurt ect.. Maison is a quant little hotel in a great location and with a very reasonable price. It's close to everything, including a short trolley ride (which stops across the street) to the French Quarter. It comes decorated with the royal purple, has nice large bathrooms and comfy beds. Sure the doors are old and dirty, the curtains don't fully close and we discovered a huge cockroach in the bathroom, but beyond that it's a great deal!
